steps.title: locate vlabench entity · grasp vlabench entity
steps.code:
loc_jessie = primitives.call(name="locate_vlabench_entity", entity_name="jessie")
print("loc_jessie ok:", loc_jessie.ok)
if loc_jessie.ok:
    jessie_handle = loc_jessie.output.get("evidence_handle") or loc_jessie.output.get("handle")
    print("jessie output keys:", list(loc_jessie.output.keys()), "handle:", jessie_handle)
    grasp_res = primitives.call(
        name="grasp_vlabench_entity",
        entity_name="jessie",
        evidence_handles=[jessie_handle] if jessie_handle else [],
    )
    print("grasp ok:", grasp_res.ok)
    if grasp_res.ok:
        lift_res = primitives.call(
            name="lift_vlabench_ee",
            evidence_handles=[jessie_handle] if jessie_handle else [],
            lift_height=0.25,
        )
        print("lift ok:", lift_res.ok)
        loc_box = primitives.call(name="locate_vlabench_entity", entity_name="giftbox_seen")
        print("loc_box ok:", loc_box.ok)
        if loc_box.ok:
            box_handle = loc_box.output.get("evidence_handle") or loc_box.output.get("handle")
            place_res = primitives.call(
                name="place_vlabench_entity_in",
                container_name="giftbox_seen",
                evidence_handles=[box_handle] if box_handle else [],
                use_native_place_point=True,
            )
            print("place ok:", place_res.ok)
            settle_res = primitives.call(name="settle_vlabench_scene", horizon=10)
            print("settle ok:", settle_res.ok)

steps.title: locate vlabench entity · move vlabench ee to · place vlabench entity in
steps.code:
loc_box = primitives.call(name="locate_vlabench_entity", entity_name="giftbox_seen")
box_handle = loc_box.output.get("evidence_handle")
print("box_handle:", box_handle)

# First lift higher to clear all obstacles (woody and giftbox walls)
m_high = primitives.call(
    name="move_vlabench_ee_to",
    evidence_handles=[box_handle],
    target_position=[0.242, 0.355, 1.12],
    target_euler=[3.14159, 0.0, 1.5708],
    gripper_state=0.0,
    horizon=15,
)
print("m_high ok:", m_high.ok)

# Now call place_vlabench_entity_in
loc_box2 = primitives.call(name="locate_vlabench_entity", entity_name="giftbox_seen")
box_handle2 = loc_box2.output.get("evidence_handle")
place_res = primitives.call(
    name="place_vlabench_entity_in",
    container_name="giftbox_seen",
    evidence_handles=[box_handle2],
    use_native_place_point=True,
)
print("place ok:", place_res.ok)

settle_res = primitives.call(name="settle_vlabench_scene", horizon=15)
print("settle ok:", settle_res.ok)

obs4 = primitives.call(name="observe_vlabench_scene")
print("jessie xpos after place:", obs4.output["object_grounding_evidence"]["entity_evidence"]["jessie"]["xpos"])
print("box xpos:", obs4.output["object_grounding_evidence"]["entity_evidence"]["giftbox_seen"]["xpos"])
